name: InstitutionSpecificRestrictionForInference
summary: The card component of Institution Specific Restriction for inference (DUO_0000028). The requester is a member of an allowed institution and owns the script: the ScriptOwnershipCredential is signed by the requester's own wallet, and checked against the key its WalletVerifyingKeyCredential attests. Outputs, for the script, the InferenceGrantCredential that Grant inference takes.

allowedInstitutions.description: Allowed institution identifiers. An AffiliationCredential qualifies if claims.isMemberOf is in this list.
